period.freeze_rule: Exclude current token-history request and all later work.

source.privacy: Only usage metadata; no prompts, credentials or raw logs.

scope.policy: Prior implementation ancestry plus v0.3 thread and descendants. Independent keyboard/power tasks excluded. Guardians separate.

method: Sum token_usage_record.usage; own thread only; response_id deduplicated, global uniqueness asserted; compare lifetime ledger with thread_token_usage. Cache and reasoning are subsets, not added twice.

pricing.basis: Standard API equivalent, not subscription bill or actual service tier
